name: AT&T Inc.
description: AT&T operates two reportable segments: Communications (Mobility wireless, Business Wireline serving enterprise/wholesale customers, and Consumer Wireline broadband including AT&T Fiber) and Latin America (wireless service and equipment in Mexico). AT&T completed the sale of its remaining 70% stake in DirecTV to TPG Capital on 2025-07-02, fully exiting the traditional pay-TV business it had entered via the 2015 DirecTV and 2018 Time Warner acquisitions (Time Warner/WarnerMedia was separately spun off and merged with Discovery in 2022). AT&T's current strategy centers on converged fiber-plus-wireless growth, targeting more than 40 million fiber passings by the end of 2026 and continuing to buy AT&T Internet Air fixed-wireless subscribers in areas without fiber.

businessLines.name: Mobility
businessLines.description: Nationwide wireless service (postpaid and prepaid, under AT&T, AT&T Business, Cricket and AT&T PREPAID brands) plus wireless equipment sales; the dominant profit driver of the Communications segment.
businessLines.source: web search of AT&T FY2025 10-K segment disclosure, 2026-09-28

businessLines.name: Business Wireline
businessLines.description: Broadband, networking and voice/data services sold to enterprise, government and wholesale (other carrier) customers, marketed under AT&T Business.
businessLines.source: web search of AT&T FY2025 10-K segment disclosure, 2026-09-28

businessLines.name: Consumer Wireline
businessLines.description: Broadband internet (AT&T Fiber, AT&T Internet Air fixed wireless, and legacy DSL) plus legacy telephony voice service sold to consumers.
businessLines.source: web search of AT&T FY2025 10-K segment disclosure, 2026-09-28

businessLines.name: Latin America
businessLines.description: Wireless service and equipment sales in Mexico.
businessLines.revenueNote: Reported as ~3% of total segment operating revenues; exact dollar figure not independently confirmed in sources reviewed

brands.note: Primary consumer and business wireless brand

brands.name: AT&T Fiber / AT&T Internet Air
brands.note: Fiber and fixed-wireless broadband brands; acquired Lumen's mass-market fiber/broadband business to accelerate fiber footprint

brands.name: DirecTV
brands.note: Fully divested: AT&T sold its remaining 70% DirecTV stake to TPG Capital, closing 2025-07-02 for ~$7.6bn in cash payments through 2029; AT&T retains no operating stake
